name: Zach Lanier
biography: is a Senior Security Researcher at Duo Security. Though an old net/web/app pen tester type, he has been researching mobile and embedded device security since 2009, ranging from app security, to platform security (especially Android); to device, network, and carrier security. He has presented at various public and private industry conferences, such as BlackHat, DEFCON, INFILTRATE, ShmooCon, RSA, Amazon ZonCon, and more. He is also a co-author of the "Android Hacker's Handbook" (published by Wiley). Twitter: @quine Web: https://www.duosecurity.com ; https://n0where.org ; http://builditsecure.ly
